$comment: 语法大厅 G07（V0.9 P1b）。锚点：此刻正在演奏。「be 举牌 + 动词穿 -ing 演出服」的直播意象与八课 L4 一致。全部内容原创。
title: 现在进行时
ketNote: Look!/Listen! 触发的进行时是 KET 听读高频；漏 be 或漏 -ing 是写作黄区常客。八课里的亲戚是 L4。

sections.essence: 现在进行时 = be + 动词-ing：给「此刻正在发生」的事拍直播。
sections.why: 中文说「正在」只需要加一个词：「我正在写作业」，动词「写」一动不动。英语要动两处：be 先举牌宣布「现在直播中」，动词再穿上 -ing 的演出服——两件套缺一不可。没有 be 的 I doing 像没开机的摄像机，没有 -ing 的 I am do 像没换装就上台。为什么要两件？因为它们各管一半：be 负责报时（是现在，不是过去），-ing 负责报状态（正在进行，还没结束）。少一件，观众就不知道你在播什么。
sections.metaphorStory: 排练厅门口挂着两块牌子。墙上那块写着「本团每周六排练」——那是常态牌（一般现在时，G06 的地盘）。门上还有一块红色的牌子，只在排练进行中才亮：「正在排练，请勿打扰」——这就是直播牌。英语的直播牌必须两件套齐全：be 是开机键，-ing 是屏幕上闪的红点。Look! Lily is playing the flute.——你看的这一眼，她正在吹。镜头一关（排练结束），直播牌熄灭，句子交还给常态牌：Lily plays the flute every Saturday. 两块牌子说的是同一个人、同一支长笛，但一块说「此刻」，一块说「一直」——挂错了牌，观众就走错了片场。

cards.rule: 结构：am / is / are + 动词-ing
cards.detail: be 按人称选（同 G04 的等号），动词穿 -ing 演出服，两件缺一不可。
cards.example: I am reading. / She is singing. / They are dancing.

cards.detail: ①直接加：play → playing；②哑音 e 脱掉再穿：make → making；③重读闭音节双写尾字母：run → running；④ie 变 y：lie → lying。

cards.rule: 触发词：Look! Listen! now, at the moment
cards.detail: 这些词一出现，就是在喊「开直播」。
cards.example: Listen! Someone is playing the guitar.

cards.rule: 提问和否定都在 be 上做
cards.detail: be 是这套结构里唯一的指挥——搬它、加 not，都不请 do。
cards.example: Are you listening? / He isn't sleeping.

cards.detail: every day / often / usually 归一般现在时；now / Look! 归进行时——先看时间词再选牌子。
cards.example: She plays every day. / She is playing now.

basic.en: I am doing my homework now.
She is singing in her room.
They are dancing to the music.
We are waiting for the bus.

mid.en: Listen! Someone is playing the guitar.
The baby is sleeping, so please be quiet.
— Where is Tom? — He is reading in the library.
My parents are cooking dinner in the kitchen.
mid.cn: 我爸妈正在厨房做晚饭。

trap.en: The girls are running to the music room.
trap.cn: 姑娘们正跑向音乐教室。
trap.note: run 重读闭音节，双写 n 再穿 -ing：running。

trap.en: He is making a paper plane.
trap.note: make 的哑音 e 要先脱掉：making，不是 makeing。

trap.en: The dog is lying on the floor.
trap.note: lie 的 ie 变 y：lying。

trap.en: I usually walk to school, but today I am taking the bus.
trap.cn: 我平时走路上学，今天坐公交。
trap.note: usually 配常态牌，today 这次配直播牌——一句话两块牌。

trap.en: She is swimming in the pool.

trap.note: know、like、want 这类「心里的状态」不上直播——说 I am knowing 反而错。

redBlack.bad: Listen! She sings in her room.
redBlack.good: Listen! She is singing in her room.
redBlack.why: Listen! 在喊「开直播」，却挂了常态牌——听的人以为你在介绍她的习惯，不是让人听此刻的歌声。

redBlack.bad: I am go to school now.
redBlack.good: I am going to school now.
redBlack.why: be 开了机，动词却没换装——「正在去」还是「打算去」说不清，两个意思打架。

redBlack.bad: He is play the drum now.
redBlack.good: He is playing the drum now.
redBlack.why: 直播两件套缺了 -ing——be 后面不能跟动词原形。
缺了开机键 be——光有 -ing 不成句。

redBlack.bad: She is runing after the dog.
redBlack.good: She is running after the dog.
redBlack.why: run 要双写 n 再穿 -ing：running。
write 的哑音 e 先脱掉：writing。

redBlack.bad: The boys are swiming in the river.
redBlack.good: The boys are swimming in the river.

redBlack.why: 直播句的指挥是 be，不是 do——What are you doing?
know 是心里的状态不是动作，不上直播——用一般现在时。

redBlack.bad: Look! The bird is fliing in the sky.
redBlack.good: Look! The bird is flying in the sky.
redBlack.why: fly 直接穿 -ing：flying——y 不用变。

redBlack.good: He is travelling in Yunnan. / He is traveling in Yunnan.
redBlack.why: travel 英式双写 l、美式不双写——两边都对，不挡意思不扣分。
love 按语法书不上直播，但广告和口语天天这么说——不挡意思，KET 不设这个坑。

contrast.cn: 我正在写作业。（加「正在」，动词不动）
contrast.en: I am doing my homework.（be 和 -ing 都要动）
contrast.diff: 中文加一个词；英语动两处——开机 be + 换装 -ing，两件套。

contrast.cn: 他弹琴。/ 他正在弹琴。（差两个字）
contrast.en: He plays. / He is playing.（差一整套形态）
contrast.diff: 中文换词，英语换牌子——常态牌与直播牌是两套系统。

contrast.en: It is raining!（必须请 it 当主语）
contrast.diff: 英语的直播句也要主语齐全，天气用 it 占位。

contrast.cn: 你在干什么？（「在」字轻轻一点）
contrast.en: What are you doing?（be 提到句首）
contrast.diff: 中文加字，英语搬 be——直播句提问不请 do。

contrast.cn: 我知道。我正在知道。（第二句中文也怪）
contrast.en: I know.（不说 I am knowing）
contrast.diff: 两种语言难得一致：心里的状态没法「正在」——know/like/want 不上直播。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 看到 Look、Listen、now——开机 be，换装 -ing，两件缺一不可
steps: 找时间信号：Look! / Listen! / now / at the moment → 直播牌；every day / often → 常态牌（G06）。
确定开直播 → 先放开机键 be：I am / 单数 is / 复数 are。
动词穿 -ing 演出服：直接加 / 脱哑音 e / 双写尾字母 / ie 变 y。
检查两件套是否齐全：少 be 或少 -ing 都不成句。
know / like / want 这类心里的状态不上直播——保持一般现在时。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语说『正在做什么』要开直播：先按开机键（am/is/are），再给动词穿上带 -ing 的演出服，两样缺一不可。咱们玩直播游戏：我做一个动作，你当解说员用中文喊『妈妈正在喝水！』然后告诉我英语的两件套是哪两件。再考考你：『看！』『听！』这种词一出来，该挂直播牌还是每周排练那块常态牌？」不用懂英语，只要帮她盯住一件事：说「正在」的句子，是不是既有 be 又有 -ing——少了哪一件都提醒她。
questions: 英语的「正在」为什么要动两个地方？哪两个？
「看！他在游泳」和「他每天游泳」——用的是同一块牌子吗？
「我知道答案」能说成「我正在知道答案」吗？英语里呢？

sections.echo: -ing 这件演出服本来不属于动词：几百年前它是名词的词尾（the singing 唱歌这件事、the building 建造这件事），后来一点点爬进动词系统，成了进行时的制服。所以今天你还能看到它的两副面孔：Swimming is fun（游泳这件事，名词）和 She is swimming（她正在游，动词）。语法零件也会挪窝换岗——今天的规则，是昨天的习惯用出来的。

stages.name: 选一选 · 开机又换装

questions.q: Look! The children ___ in the playground.
questions.explain: Look! 触发直播；children 复数——are playing。

questions.q: I ___ my homework now.
questions.explain: now 触发直播：am + doing 两件套。

questions.q: She ___ a letter at the moment.
questions.explain: at the moment 直播中；write 脱 e——writing。

questions.q: Listen! Someone ___ the guitar.
We ___ for the school concert this week.
questions.explain: 这阵子正在准备——直播牌 are practising。

questions.q: The baby ___ now. Be quiet!
___ you ___ to me?
questions.explain: 直播句提问搬 be：Are you listening?

questions.q: He ___ a kite in the park.
My parents ___ dinner in the kitchen.
Hurry up! The bus ___.
questions.explain: 眼前正开过来——is coming（come 脱 e）。

questions.q: Lily ___ under the big tree.
They ___ a film at the moment.
I ___ my school uniform today.
Look! It ___ outside.
The girls ___ photos of the band.
Mr Li ___ on the phone right now.
哪一句的直播是健康的？（他在打鼓）
questions.explain: 两件套齐全才成句：is + playing。

questions.q: 哪一句的直播是健康的？（我在画画）
questions.explain: 缺 be 或缺 -ing 都不行。

questions.q: 哪一句的拼写是健康的？（她在跑）
哪一句是健康的？（看！他在游）
questions.explain: Look! 触发直播；swim 双写 m。

questions.q: 哪一句的提问是健康的？（你在干嘛）
questions.explain: 直播句的指挥是 be——What are you doing?

questions.q: 哪一句的拼写是健康的？（他在写信）
哪一句是健康的？（别吵，宝宝在睡）
哪一句是健康的？（我知道答案）
questions.explain: know 是心里的状态，不上直播。

questions.q: 哪一句的否定是健康的？（他没在睡）
questions.explain: 否定在 be 上做：isn't sleeping。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（狗趴在地上）
options: The dog is lying on the floor.
The dog is lieing on the floor.
The dog is liing on the floor.
questions.explain: lie 的 ie 变 y——lying。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（他们此刻在踢球）
哪一句是健康的？（她在做蛋糕）
哪一句是健康的？（鸟在天上飞）
options: The bird is flying in the sky.
The bird is fliing in the sky.
The bird is flys in the sky.

questions.q: 哪一句的简答是健康的？（——在听吗？——在）
options: — Are you listening? — Yes, I am.
— Are you listening? — Yes, I do.
— Do you listening? — Yes, I am.
questions.explain: be 提问 be 简答：Yes, I am。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（公交正在停下）
哪一句是健康的？（爷爷在打太极？不——爷爷每天打）
options: Grandpa does tai chi every morning.
Grandpa is doing tai chi every morning.
Grandpa doing tai chi every morning.
questions.explain: every morning 是习惯——常态牌，不开直播。

questions.q: Look! Lily ___ the flute on the stage.
Lily ___ the flute every day after school.
questions.explain: every day 是习惯——常态牌 plays。

questions.q: — Where is Tom? — He ___ in the library.
questions.explain: 此刻他人在哪、在干嘛——直播牌。

questions.q: Listen! The birds ___ in the tree.
I usually ___ to school, but today I ___ the bus.
questions.explain: usually 配常态牌，today 这次配直播牌——一句两牌。

questions.q: Don't talk! We ___ to the new song.
Take your umbrella. It ___ outside.
— What ___ the twins ___ now? — They ___ their room.
questions.explain: 问句 are...doing；答句 are cleaning——全程直播牌。

questions.q: My sister ___ now, so I ___ TV with the sound off.
questions.explain: 两个「此刻」都开直播：is sleeping、am watching。

questions.q: She can't answer the phone. She ___ a shower.
questions.explain: 此刻在洗澡——is having（have 脱 e）。

questions.q: The train ___ ! Run, or we'll miss it!
questions.explain: 眼看就要开走——直播牌 is leaving。

questions.q: I ___ this song. It sounds beautiful.
questions.explain: like 是心里的状态——不上直播。

questions.q: Look at the picture: a girl ___ under a tree and two boys ___ nearby.
questions.explain: 看图描述用直播牌；sit、run 都要双写。

questions.q: — ___ it still ___ outside? — No, it has stopped.
questions.explain: 直播句提问搬 be：Is it still raining?

questions.q: Shh! The conductor ___ something important.
questions.explain: 此刻正在说——is saying（say 直接穿）。

questions.q: 大考：Mum ___ dinner, Dad ___ the floor, and I ___ my homework.
options: is cooking / is cleaning / am doing
questions.explain: 全家同时直播：三个主语三个 be，动词全穿 -ing。

detective.sentence: Look! He swim in the river.
detective.fixed: Look! He is swimming in the river.
detective.clue: Look! 在喊开直播——要 be + -ing 两件套，swim 还要双写 m。

detective.sentence: She is danceing in the hall.
detective.fixed: She is dancing in the hall.
detective.clue: dance 的哑音 e 要先脱掉再穿 -ing——dancing。

detective.sentence: I am watch TV with my sister.
detective.fixed: I am watching TV with my sister.
detective.clue: 开了机（am）却没换装——动词要穿 -ing。

detective.sentence: They playing football on the playground now.
detective.fixed: They are playing football on the playground now.
detective.clue: 有 -ing 却没开机——缺了 be（are）。

detective.sentence: The baby is sleep in the bedroom.
detective.fixed: The baby is sleeping in the bedroom.
detective.clue: be 后面不能跟动词原形——sleep 要穿 -ing。

detective.sentence: Listen! Lily sings in her room.
detective.fixed: Listen! Lily is singing in her room.
detective.clue: Listen! 触发直播牌——is singing，不是常态牌 sings。

detective.sentence: He is runing after the school bus.
detective.fixed: He is running after the school bus.
detective.clue: run 重读闭音节，双写 n 再穿 -ing——running。
